summary: Frontend-only demo mode verification of FirstRunTour (matches/builder/research), contextual help pills (cohort/activity/pitch), and ConversationalOnboarding polish (6-step stepper, why-hint, progress). Ran 46 targeted Playwright checks across desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) viewports. All 46 assertions passed. No source files modified.

test_scenarios_verified.demo_entry: GET /demo redirects to /dashboard/founder and establishes preview-demo session (client-side).
test_scenarios_verified.matches_tour: Appears within ~4s with 4 steps, indicator '1/4'→'2/4', Back appears from step 2, last button reads 'Got it·Κατάλαβα', closes on click, localStorage 'cfb.tour.matches.preview-demo-user'='done', not shown after reload.
test_scenarios_verified.builder_tour: 3 steps, Skip (X) button closes and persists 'cfb.tour.builder.preview-demo-user'='done'.
test_scenarios_verified.research_tour: 3 steps, ArrowRight advances (1/3→2/3), ArrowLeft goes back, Escape dismisses and persists 'cfb.tour.research.preview-demo-user'='done'.
test_scenarios_verified.mobile_tour: On 390x844, tour card renders near bottom (y≈610, height≈222, within viewport), no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390), skip button visible/tappable.
test_scenarios_verified.contextual_help: Help pill present on /org/cohorts/cohort-autumn-2026 (aria-label 'How to read this cohort'), /activity ('What each tab shows'), /pitch/demo-1 ('Reading this pitch'). Cohort help opens content referencing Participants/Mentoring.
test_scenarios_verified.onboarding_polish: With cookie cfb_session=test-session (fresh context), /onboarding renders. onboarding-header present, counter shows 'Step 1 of 6·Βήμα 1 από 6' (bilingual), 6 stepper testids visible (name/role/headline/location/bio/skills), progressbar present, onboarding-why-hint present and text changes between steps.
test_scenarios_verified.onboarding_flow: Name→Role(Founder)→Headline (Next disabled while empty, enabled after typing)→Location (Next enabled while empty)→Bio (bio-input/skip-bio/continue-button)→Skills (complete-button). Counter increments Step 1→6 correctly.
test_scenarios_verified.regression_smoke: /dashboard/founder, /discover, /messages, /settings, /expert-reviews all return HTTP 200 in demo mode.

observed_console_noise_not_bugs: CSP warning for cloudflareinsights beacon.min.js (external analytics blocked, expected).
Next.js webpack-hmr WebSocket 502 (dev-server HMR through preview proxy, does not affect functionality).
One hydration attribute mismatch on /expert-reviews (server/client branch mismatch) — cosmetic, doesn't break page render.
One 403 resource load on /pitch/demo-1 (likely external avatar/opengraph, non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: Consider silencing/fixing the hydration attribute mismatch on /expert-reviews (SSR-only content in Client Component) to prevent flaky visual states; not blocking.
test_credentials: None required. Demo mode via GET /demo (sets cfb_session=preview-demo). Onboarding tested with cookie cfb_session=test-session in a fresh context (no /demo visit).
seed_data_creation: None. Used built-in preview demo mocks (apps/web/src/lib/preview-demo.ts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All FirstRunTour, contextual help, and onboarding features work as specified. Tour storage keys confirmed: cfb.tour.{matches|builder|research}.preview-demo-user='done'. Escape/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keyboard handlers work. For onboarding tests, MUST use a fresh browser context with only cookie cfb_session=test-session set (do NOT visit /demo first — the preview-demo user has onboarding_completed=true and gets redirected to /profile).
